queries: WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS test_count FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), group_stats AS (SELECT AVG(test_count) AS avg_count, SUM(test_count) AS total_count FROM sex_counts) SELECT s.SEX, s.test_count, 1.0 * s.test_count / g.total_count AS fraction_of_total, s.test_count - g.avg_count AS above_average_by FROM sex_counts AS s CROSS JOIN group_stats AS g WHERE s.test_count > g.avg_count

WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS test_count FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), eligible AS (SELECT SEX, test_count, test_count - (SELECT AVG(test_count) FROM sex_counts) AS above_average_by FROM sex_counts WHERE test_count > (SELECT AVG(test_count) FROM sex_counts)) SELECT SEX, test_count, 1.0 * test_count / SUM(test_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, above_average_by FROM eligible

WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS test_count FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(test_count) AS average_count FROM sex_counts), qualifying AS (SELECT sc.sex, sc.test_count, ga.average_count FROM sex_counts AS sc CROSS JOIN group_average AS ga WHERE sc.test_count > ga.average_count) SELECT sex, test_count, CAST(test_count AS REAL) / SUM(test_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, test_count - average_count AS above_average FROM qualifying
